card.name: Word starts dur- and preced- in drug text
card.fires_on: The first piece of words beginning dur- or preced-, such as durvalumab, duration, DURYSTA and precede, in drug-label text. It responds on the piece before the rest of the word is spelled out.

modes.label: Dur- in names
modes.description: The start of durvalumab, DURYSTA or heloma durum, where the word is only partly written.
modes.example: Administer IMJUDO prior to<< dur>>valumab on the same day.

modes.label: Preced- verb
modes.description: The start of the verb precede, meaning to come before something, such as symptoms or findings.
modes.example: Persistent abnormalities in liver function tests may<< preced>>e appearance of fibrosis or cirrh

modes.label: Dur- in duration
modes.description: The start of the word duration in a heading about treatment length.
modes.example: Recommended Target INR Ranges and<< Dur>>ations for Individual Indications
